entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. This is absolutely ridiculous. I need to return something right now.
I understand your frustration, and I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, may I have your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, order 774-B2-901. And you better solve this, because I'm one second away from demanding your manager and posting this terrible experience all over social media.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the performance jersey delivered on January 8th. I'm here to help resolve this for you. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size! It's ridiculously too tight. I can barely get it on. I need to do an exchange for a larger size, or just give me my money back. This shouldn't be this hard!
Okay, thank you for clarifying. It sounds like a sizing issue. Let me just quickly review our policy for you.
Don't 'review the policy' with me, just do the return! I bought it 18 days ago. This is a simple request.

You are absolutely correct, Sam. My apologies. I've confirmed that your jersey is a standard item and you are well within our 90-day return period. I can process this for you immediately. Would you prefer a full refund or an exchange for the next size up?
Fine. A refund. I'll just buy it somewhere else. Send me the shipping label.

Of course. I have just initiated the full refund process and emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just package the jersey and drop it off with the carrier. Once it's scanned into their system, your refund will be released. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. Just make sure it actually works. Unbelievable.
I understand. I've noted the account to ensure it's processed smoothly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
